ingredientsSection.subtitle: Every ingredient is dosed for daily, sustainable use with published human evidence guiding the number. Values shown per tablet.

items.name: Co-enzyme Q10
items.description: Mitochondrial ATP synthesis cofactor. Rate-limiting for cellular energy production. Dosed at the threshold at which serum levels reliably rise in adults over 40.

items.name: Trans-Resveratrol
items.description: SIRT1 activator and modulator of NF-κB inflammaging signalling. Dosed for cognitive and cardiovascular support in adults over 30.

items.name: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
items.description: Universal antioxidant, water and lipid soluble. Regenerates Vitamins C and E. Dosed within the evidence-supported daily range.

items.name: Vitamin C (L-Ascorbic Acid)
items.description: Recycles oxidised Vitamin E and glutathione. Collagen synthesis cofactor. Foundational antioxidant network anchor. 50% RDA (Men) · 61.53% RDA (Women).

items.name: Vitamin E (Tocotrienols)
items.description: Membrane-resident lipid-phase antioxidant. Tocotrienol isoforms cross the blood-brain barrier and reach cardiovascular tissue. 100% RDA.

items.name: Lycopene
items.description: Lipid peroxidation chain terminator. Supports cardiovascular function. Completes the carotenoid antioxidant spectrum with Astaxanthin.

items.name: Astaxanthin
items.description: Carotenoid antioxidant. Crosses blood-brain and blood-retina barriers. Modulates NF-κB signalling. Dosed for daily sustainable use.

items.name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)
items.description: Contributes to healthy vitamin D status in adults. Supports immune, cardiovascular, and bone function. 100% RDA.

items.name: Vitamin K2-7 (MK-7)
items.description: Activates osteocalcin, directing calcium to bone tissue. Essential D3 partner molecule for extended daily supplementation. 81.81% RDA.

items.name: Selenium (Sodium selenite)
items.description: Rate-limiting cofactor for the GPx1 to GPx5 enzymatic antioxidant cascade. Complements CoQ10 for cardiovascular support. Addresses India's selenium-deficient soil gap. 100% RDA.

items.a: Adults over 30 looking for an expertly composed foundational healthspan nutraceutical. It is designed to be taken alongside a normal diet. If you are pregnant, lactating, on blood thinners, or managing a serious condition, get medical clearance before starting.

items.q: How long until I notice the effects?
items.a: Serum levels of the fat-soluble actives (D3, K2, Astaxanthin, Tocotrienols) stabilise across 8–12 weeks. Most subjective effects — energy, sleep quality, cognitive clarity — settle in that window. Give it a full 90-day cycle before evaluating.

items.q: Can I take AETERNYX® with my other medicines?
items.a: The formulation contains no drug actives and no supra-therapeutic doses. That said, Vitamin K2 can interact with warfarin and other coumarin anticoagulants — if you are on those, get medical clearance before starting.

items.q: Is it safe to take long-term?
items.a: Every dose sits within the tolerable upper intake level (UL) established in the evidence base. The D3 + K2 pairing is specifically designed to make long-term supplementation safer than D3 alone. Annual medical review is still advisable.

items.q: Why one tablet rather than a stack of pills?
items.a: Compliance. Ten separate bottles is the reason most nutraceutical protocols fail. A single daily tablet is what actually gets taken every day.
Yes. Every active is plant-derived or synthetic. The Vitamin D3 uses a vegetarian source (lichen-derived cholecalciferol). No gelatin, no animal excipients.

At the doses used, side effects are uncommon. Some individuals report mild gastric warmth from Astaxanthin or mild yellowing of the palm (harmless, from Lycopene) at first. Take with food to minimise both.
AETERNYX® is manufactured by SunBeam Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd. in Puducherry, India — an ISO 22000/9001/14001, WHO-GMP, and HACCP certified facility. FSSAI licence 10020045000187.

story.title: Why we exist
paragraphs: Arata Nutraceuticals was founded on a single conviction: the supplement industry in India had drifted dangerously far from the published evidence. Bottles claimed everything, evidence supported almost nothing. Doses were marketing artefacts. Excipients outweighed actives.

We work backwards from the published evidence. Every molecule in every Arata product is included because there is a defensible reason for it to be there, at the dose it is at. Anything that cannot survive that test is not in the tablet.
AETERNYX® is the first of a planned portfolio of expertly composed healthspan nutraceuticals. Each is engineered for a specific axis of healthspan, and each is held to the same standard.
